ChooChooTracker privacy policy

Effective date: 2026-09-10

ChooChooTracker does not collect, receive, transmit, sell, or share personal data. The app has no account system, advertising, analytics, or network service.

Projects, samples, settings, and exports are stored only on your device. The publisher does not have access to them. Android's system file picker is used only when you choose to import or export a file.

For privacy questions, contact pierre@project1404.com.
